name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
summary: Jointly established by the Ministry of MSME and SIDBI to catalyse institutional credit to Micro & Small Enterprises by providing collateral- and/or third-party-guarantee-free credit guarantee cover through eligible Member Lending Institutions (MLIs).

source.verified_by: Claude (WebFetch retrieval, quoted verbatim from the live CGTMSE homepage)

_body:
## CGTMSE

"Guarantee cover to collateral and/or third party guarantee free credit
facilities extended by eligible Member Lending Institution [MLIs] to MSEs."
The maximum guarantee coverage ceiling is stated as ₹10 crore (recently
increased). See [[CGTMSE-GUARANTEE-FEE]] for the fee.

> **What this vault note does NOT claim.** The prior research catalog for
> this project (and general public knowledge about CGTMSE) describes a
> tiered 75–85% guarantee coverage percentage and a fuller fee slab
> structure by loan size and borrower category. The CGTMSE **homepage**
> fetched here does not state a coverage percentage at all, and states
> only a single minimum fee figure, not a slab table. Rather than carry
> forward the unverified tiered figures from the research catalog, this
> note records only what was actually confirmed from the live page.
> Fetching the CGTMSE scheme-guidelines PDF (linked from this homepage,
> not yet fetched) is the next step to fill this gap — see the ambiguity
> flag on the fee record.
